facts: It describes the museum in Pyoseon-myeon, Seogwipo, with parking and tasting.
It describes exhibits on traditional-liquor types and brewing, Korean and foreign liquor, and 1970s-80s bottles and advertisements.
It describes Jeju gosori-sul and omegi-sul exhibits and sales, with an address and hours.
Lists World Liquor Museum as a cultural facility at 431 Hanmaeum Elementary School-ro, Pyoseon-myeon, Seogwipo, Jeju.
Visit Jeju search results include World Liquor Museum among exhibition facilities.
